title: exec-staff-meeting-prep-notes-2026-03-11
content:
Top-level goal: prep for Exec Staff sync (Tue 03/11 09:00 PT) — align on near-term product priorities, Dedicated SLA rollout, Private pilot status, and key GTM asks.

Attendees: CEO (Tom), CTO (Ava), CFO (Daniel), Head of Sales (Maya), Head of PD (Sofia), Head of Eng (Evan), Head of Customer (Priya) — note: Marcus joining for SLA discussion.

Agenda (30m):
- 09:00-09:03 Quick round / pulse (2-3 bullets each)
- 09:03-09:12 Dedicated: SLA rollout & capacity plan (Evan + Marcus) — status, remaining risks, customer impact
- 09:12-09:18 Private pilot: 2 customers onboarding (Sofia) — blockers, infra/ops needs, security signoffs
- 09:18-09:24 Cost/ops: short-term runway implications / Q2 commit sensitivity (Daniel)
- 09:24-09:28 GTM readiness & launch messaging (Maya)
- 09:28-09:30 Decisions and next steps / action owners

Prep notes / talking points:
- Dedicated SLA: current ETA for GA is 3/20. Remaining infra blockers: autoscaler edge case with multi-tenancy (ENG-789), short-term mitigation is reserved pools + manual routing. Marcus to present risk table + mitigation timeframe (expect fix in 2 sprints). Need decision on whether to ship GA with manual routing for tiered customers (reduced automation) or delay by 2 weeks.
- Private pilot: Customer A (healthcare) waiting on KMS integration + audit logs. Ops needs final IAM playbook and one on-call rotation from SRE until pilot completes. Ask: approve 0.5 FTE temporary SRE support (2 months).
- Cost/runway: Daniel flagged Q2-commit sensitivity if we accelerate Dedicated capacity for 2 large customers (estimated incremental monthly committed spend $220k). Request: finance-run scenario table for 3 commit options (conservative / base / aggressive) by EOD Wed.
- GTM: Marketing draft 1 for Dedicated launch ready Thurs; need exec sign-off on messaging re: SLAs and data isolation. Ask Sales to confirm top 5 customers to invite to early access.

Risks / escalation flags:
- If autoscaler regression persists, could impact latency SLO for shared pools — escalate to SRE leadership and consider temporary per-customer reserved instances.
- KMS/HSM integration timeline may push Private pilot >4 weeks if security review uncovers gaps; schedule weekly sync with security team.

Decisions needed in meeting:
1) Ship Dedicated GA on 3/20 with manual routing for some customers (yes/no).
2) Approve 0.5 FTE SRE support for Private pilot (yes/no).
3) Approve fast-path finance scenario (which of three) to support capacity commitments.

Action items (owner — due):
- Marcus Bennett — present autoscaler risk table + mitigation plan in meeting (03/11 meeting) — OWNER: Marcus — DUE: 2026-03-11
- Evan Li — confirm which customers would be on manual routing vs automated for initial GA; create short-run runbook (DUE: 2026-03-13)
- Sofia Patel — finalize pilot onboarding checklist and share with Security + Ops (DUE: 2026-03-12)
- Daniel Reed — produce 3-runway finance scenarios and recommend option (DUE: 2026-03-11 EOD)
- Maya Chen — confirm top 5 early access customers and coordinate invite list (DUE: 2026-03-12)
- Priya Rao — draft customer comms template for SLA messaging and review with Legal (DUE: 2026-03-12)
- ENG: link to PR for autoscaler fix (GH #456) and brief QA plan; test coverage target: +1 integration test (DUE: 2026-03-20)

Notes to self (Sofia):
- Bring up the ask for temporary SRE headcount; be explicit about expected outcomes and rollback plan.
- Remind Daniel to include sensitivity if two enterprise deals accelerate (show scenario where commit covers incremental GPU reserved cost).
- On Private pilot, push for a minimal set of audit log fields required for customer signoff — avoid full-blown compliance scope if possible.

Linked docs / refs: see linked_artifacts above (confluence page with rollout plan, ENG-789 ticket, GH PR #456, Slack thread for Dedicated-GA).

Follow-ups after meeting (quick template to copy into tracker):
- Outcome for decision 1 (GA ship option): [yes/no] — notes — owner to implement — timeline
- Outcome for decision 2 (SRE support): [approved/rejected] — if approved, HR ticket + SRE assignment by EOD Thu
- Outcome for decision 3 (finance option): chosen option + incremental commit amount + impact on cash runway

Scratch / ad-hoc notes:
- Quick ask: if GA goes live with manual routing, need to update API docs and Console flow to show "Dedicated: manual routing" state. PM + Docs owner to create doc entry (DUE: 2026-03-15).
- Remind legal about updated SLA language (pull from template in Confluence page).

End of prep. Will convert to short 1-slide summary for meeting deck (top 3 bullets + decisions) after we confirm actions.
